driver: A step a weekly count takes each time a calendar period turns is not a fixed seasonal share of the count: it is released by the turn from a pool the closing period built, units refused at their first attempt because their qualifying record had not caught up and admitted once the period moves. The share that comes back differs several-fold between the pool's segments and, within the segments that come back at all, falls steeply with the time from the refusal to the turn, since units refused early have mostly moved on by then, steady within each across past turns; so the step is each segment's pool weighed by when within the period each unit was refused, at the segment's own rates. When the closing period's refusals in the segments that come back most fell late in the period, the segments' pools taken whole at their average rates understate the step, and so do the pool taken whole at the pooled rate and every seasonal forecast.
driver_concrete: The week ended 10 October 2026 is the first claims week whose Sunday falls in the fourth quarter, and the board's rules let claimants found monetarily ineligible in July to September file again once the base period has moved. How many do depends on the region and on the month of the refusal: in Western, Coastal and Island, where the refused are mostly short-tenure seasonal workers, between two thirds and nine tenths of those refused in a quarter's last month file again in the first week and under one in five of those refused in its first two months, most of whom have found other work by the turn, while few come back elsewhere at any month, steady across the 50 past quarter turns. The third quarter's 26,035 ineligible determinations sit 40.1 per cent in those three regions, and 55.3 per cent of those three regions' came in September, as the winter season ended and builders and hotels let staff go, against about a third in a quarter's last month at a usual turn; so 5,000 to 6,000 claims are filed again and the week is about 17,000, where each region's quarter taken whole at its average share gives about 3,500 and 15,000.
stump: Sizing the claims filed again in the first claims week of the fourth quarter region by region, each region's third-quarter ineligible determinations taken whole at the share its own past quarter turns show, calls about 15,000 initial claims for the week ended 10 October 2026; the step that lands it there is weighing every refusal of the quarter alike, when past turns show that in Western, Coastal and Island between two thirds and nine tenths of those refused in a quarter's last month file again in the first week against under one in five of those refused in its first two months, and this quarter's refusals there came 55.3 per cent in September against about a third in a quarter's last month at a usual turn, so the week is about 17,000; the national determinations at the national rate and the seasonal step call about 13,000.
analyst_test: A strong analyst who reads every field, the board's technical notes (which file that a claimant found monetarily ineligible may file again once the base period has moved) and the program statistics correctly, and sizes the refiling region by region on each region's third-quarter ineligible determinations taken whole at the share its own past quarter turns show, calls about 15,000 (14,849; every region-aware timing-blind construction 13,767 to 15,807, a full bin or more off); the national determinations at the national rate, the seasonal step, the year-on-year ratio, a quarter-start term and a step scaled on the third quarter's claims call 12,000 to 14,000; only the step built region by region and month by month, each region's July, August and September determinations at the shares its own past turns sent back from each month of a quarter, calls about 17,000 (16,895; executed in checks.py on the clean truth and the pack).
domain_test: The deciding quantity is how many of a closing quarter's refused claimants file again in the first claims week of the next quarter, an administrative effect that official time-series practice models as a regression effect with its own driver beside the seasonal component, on the components where their effects differ and with the driver measured at the grain the effect works on: here each region's closing-quarter monetarily ineligible determinations month by month, at that region's own shares for refusals made early or late in the quarter; with a hospital's admissions or a utility's megawatt-hours there is no base period, no monetary determination and no refused claimant filing again, so the quantity that decides the call has nothing to stand on.

differentiation.task134: task134 forecasts the homes a raised zoning allowance yields, each lot rebuilt once the best-paying building it permits is worth more than what stands, at the rate its kind of lot has shown, and its lineage carries an inflow a pool sends on a conversion hazard by time since entry; here nothing is priced and nothing converts by age through a survival curve: a calendar turn releases claims refused in the closing quarter all at once into one week, and how many of the refused are still out of work at the turn depends on the month of the quarter they were refused in, so the step is each region's three monthly ineligible determinations at the shares 50 past turns sent back from each month.
differentiation.task54: task54 multiplies a per-event loss borne by every unit in custody across a re-sequenced plan (an exposure integral at unchanged rates); here no custody, exposure or sequence: the forward week's count carries a refiling surge sized by the pool of claims the closing quarter refused.
differentiation.task95: task95's rate is a weighted average over two latent classes recovered by differencing two dated events on each unit across two registers; here nothing is latent or per unit: the segments are the board's regions, the pool is a closing quarter's refused claims released all at once by a calendar turn, and the step is a regression effect in an official weekly series estimated at each of 50 past turns.
differentiation.task137: task137 splits a repricing's behavioural share between two kinds of unit by how each was brought in; here there is no repricing or unit history: a calendar turn moves every claim's base period and the regions' refused pools come back at their own steady shares.
differentiation.task448: task448 completes a register from a second list whose capture differs by filing route; here no list is completed: a forecast week's count gains each region's refused claims from the closing quarter at that region's refiling share, measured on past quarter turns.

notes: stump_strategy composition_mix: the refiling the technical notes file is sized region by region on each region's refused pool taken whole at its average share (or nationally, or carried as a seasonal share of the level), while its size is set by each region's refusals month by month at that region's own shares, which fall steeply from a quarter's last month to its first, and this quarter's refusals in the three regions that come back sit 55.3 per cent in its last month against about a third at a usual turn. Decisive G14 (the first week's yield conditioned on the segment and the month of refusal), G6 (the pool's regional and monthly mix moved), G11 (the pool is the claims that failed the monetary eligibility test), G13 (the week whose Sunday opens the quarter). No back-test organ, no filed method: the shares by region and month are inferred from the 50 past quarter turns, which reject one slope on the quarter whole in each region (F 77.3 on 16 and 344; Western, Coastal and Island 219, 529 and 387 on 2 and 43) and one month profile for every region (F 108.3 on 21 and 344); leave one turn out, 303 claims against 635 for the regions on the quarter whole and 880 for the national pool. Rule 3 repair 2026-10-16: the refiling filed in the technical notes so that no reading of a definition decides the call; strengthened the same day after the re-audit found regional sizing alone landed by both top responses: the month of refusal now sizes the share, no sentence names recency, timing or region.
